answer: Autonomous agent networks in an orchard curb Sybil attacks using leaf reflectance verification. A registering agent illuminates a designated vine with a calibrated pulse and submits the reflected fluorometric signal. Because unpredictable canopy scattering cannot be simulated, attackers must provision discrete optical sensors and physical field space per identity. However, variable sunlight and dew condensation can distort measurements, occasionally causing false rejections of valid agents.
